sam: T-12m: quick readiness check for change window. Short bullets + GO/NO-GO please.

sam: Plan: canary 5% us-east, model pinned v3.2.0, warm cache enabled, release notes: https://internal/release/3.2.0. Quiet window T+5m for 30m.

irene: staging smoke ok. p95 115ms. minor token diff in evals but within tolerances.

harry: infra: GPU pool warmed. adjusted client timeout 9s->7s for canary.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] starting canary -> service=redwood-inference version=v3.2.0 target=5% region=us-east-1

mina: oncall: seeded KV cache with 4M tokens. watching memory and autoscale.

sam: rollback rules: auto if error-rate >3% sustained 3m; manual if p95>500ms for 5m; immediate rollback on safety regression.

irene: added rollback command to thread: `deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-inference --to v3.1.8 --reason "auto-rollback"`.

harry: monitoring dashboard shows errors 0.1%, p95 120ms, cost delta +1.4%.

oncall-bot: [oncall-bot] no active Sev1/Sev2. pager: mina. If rollback, alert #release-war-room and tag @sam.

sam: final approver for full ramp = sam or irene if unreachable. Calling for GO/NO-GO.

irene: GO from me.

harry: GO.

sam: thanks all  reconvene at T+20m for ramp decision. Keep replies minimal and only post breaches. :rocket:
